mathematical_findings: At each genuine terminal h_i, r_i=1 makes the source lower bound exact: every whole-menu j≠i IC compares chosen profit v_i to Σ_x Q_j(x)/D_i(x), D_i=p+Σ_nonlast s+1≥1. Adding the selected 20 genuine ICs, rather than subtracting two independently nonnegative sums, proves L_fk=Σ_a x_a Σ_s n_a(s)[4z−C_ak+s_k]/D_a(s)≥0 for any SPE realizing the prescribed branches.

In the specified uniform shared-T, within-group without-replacement lift, a fixed source index has word probability n_a(s)/5, and a fixed different index has conditional coordinate expectation (C_ak−s_k)/4. Hence δ_fk=Σ_a (x_a/5)Σ_s n_a(s)[z−(C_ak−s_k)/4]/D_a(s), and 20δ_fk=L_fk term by term. Cross-family conditional independence is unnecessary for this same-family identity.

The full ten terminal classes are AB coordinates 0,1,2; AE 0,1,2; S 0,1,2,3. The saved signs are 3 positive, 3 zero, 4 negative. The four negatives are precisely AB/R, AE/R, S/H, S/I. Each is a genuine terminal failure of the target’s one specified original-mass 65-label lift; this is an actual proper contribution to target statement, not a whole-target theorem.

For arbitrary coupling preserving the relevant original masses, fixed-prefix loads and same-family joint histogram, L is invariant even when its individual 20 slacks differ. Negative L forces at least one real IC failure. This correctly proves a stronger universal fixed-projection noncompletion result, but that universal quantifier lies outside the target’s original specified-lift quantifier and is now expressly excluded from target contribution accounting.

The other ten negative categories cross families. Their weighted alignment term Σ_i Q_i/D_i can change under recoupling, so this bridge does not universally certify those particular negatives. The full 255 values and 195/46/14 counts, finite rational membership construction, and six exact positive T[i] completions remain independently paid target evidence; they are not newly proved by this step.

Current common-catalog model uses a noninjective cov map and retains labels in ordered histories. Current target v2 expressly permits same-cover different labels. No label quotient or complete-strategy descent is needed. Reversing precisely the two published source replacements restores the historical v1 hash; masses, IC algebra and scalar certificates are unchanged.

The AE/R and S/I whole exclusions are already canonical c381 and a371 respectively. Reading those full edges confirms their target projections and negative fractions agree with the corresponding two sums here. The present edge targets the 65-label object only as a step and creates no duplicate whole exclusion.
